Manual backups failing. I’ll select the photos, hit the icon to manually backup, the progress bar comes up and finishes but the photos are not backed up at the end and the check mark icon showing their backed up isn’t there.

This is a new issue. I always do manual backups on my phone in this exact way (auto on iPad) and this is an issue I haven’t seen on either device over many years of use.

I received a developer response which was unhelpful and made it clear that whoever responded didn’t actually read or understand my issue.

text:
Sharing photos is a nightmare
Tried sharing photos from a family reunion, uploaded them from my phone gallery into a folder in the Google Photos app on my iPhone 13pro and shared the link. People received an empty link - only the folder existed but without the photos. Tried finding information about it but Google Photos doesn’t even have a solution. Testing other methods requires me to reselect hundreds of photos every time. Troubleshooting is impossible, no help available, FAQ not helpful. Spent hours trying to find a solution without success. What’s the point of having sharing if it doesn’t actually share anything but empty folders? And if I must upload items twice (first to Google Photos and then to a shared folder) then this is very poorly managed app with highly misleading information and no clear nor easily accessible solutions. Extremely frustrating. I am very disappointed.
context: Google Photos App Store review (1 stars, us)

text:
Functionally Useless Unless You Give It Full Access To Your Entire Photo Livrary
The app intentionally does not allow you to access any of the functions unless you give it Full Access to all of your photos, even though selective photo access is a core feature of iOS. This was possible in previously versions, and given how long this has been reported as a bug, the intent is clearly that Google wants access to each and every one of your photos - almost certainly to expand their AI datasets. Scummy and morally reprehensible behavior.
context: Google Photos App Store review (1 stars, us)
